competency_questions: Across the corpus, which approach has the higher mean reported metric, and by how much?
How many papers contribute a measurable score to each approach's mean?
If a paper reports scores on multiple benchmarks, how is it counted so that each paper contributes at most once to the aggregate?
definition: A comparison of the mean reported performance metric of retrieval augmentation methods versus fine-tuning methods across all papers in the corpus, weighted so that each paper contributes once.
needs: A numeric performance metric (e.g., accuracy, F1, BLEU) for each reported method
The benchmark or task name associated with each reported metric
Classification of each method as retrieval augmentation or fine-tuning

scope.papers: all papers in the corpus that report a numeric performance metric for at least one retrieval augmentation method and/or at least one fine-tuning method on a named benchmark

title: Aggregate performance comparison
